system_name: Adaptive Path Planning and Collision Avoidance - MathWorks Simulink Architecture
problem_statement: PS 06 - Software: Autonomous Vehicles on Unstructured Indian Roads

toolboxes.RoadRunner: High-fidelity 3D modeling of unstructured Indian rural and urban road environments with missing lanes and irregular boundaries.
toolboxes.Automated Driving Toolbox: Camera/Radar/LiDAR sensor fusion blocks, vision detection generator, and multi-object tracker.
toolboxes.Navigation Toolbox: Lattice planner, Hybrid A* kinodynamic planning, Costmap2D obstacle representation.
toolboxes.Stateflow: Supervisory finite state machine managing collision-avoidance transitions (NORMAL -> CAUTION -> EVASIVE -> SAFE_STOP).
toolboxes.Vehicle Dynamics Blockset: Nonlinear 3-DOF & 14-DOF vehicle dynamics with Pacejka tire models and Bicycle Model kinematics.
toolboxes.Simulink Bicycle Model: Bicycle model kinematics with steering-to-yaw-rate frequency response and lateral acceleration bounds.

state_variables: yaw_rate: Angular velocity around Z axis (rad/s)
